annotations.title: Everything on offer at one shop

description:
List products currently on promotion at a given supermarket, the biggest saving the shop states first. Every promotion can be reached: each call returns one page, and offset moves through the whole list. These are the shop's own offers, as it states them, on the products it still lists. Aldi runs no multibuys or member prices: its list is the price cuts and offers its own site shows.

Returns offer label (e.g. "3 for €5", "SAVE €0.75"), was-price, validity window, offer_ends (the last day the offer applies, Irish time), and where applicable Tesco Clubcard prices, SuperValu Real Rewards prices, Dunnes member offers or Lidl Plus prices (scan the Lidl Plus app at the till). next_offset is the next page's offset, and is missing on the last page. Each offer returned costs one credit.

limit.description: How many offers to return in one page (default 25, at most 200).

offset.description: How many rows to skip, for the next page: the next_offset of the page before (default 0).

store.description: The shop: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl.

name: get_promotions
